title: 北京初体验：长城、故宫与烤鸭
author: Travel Diaries

sentences.en: The hotel room was amazing, with a clear view of the Bird's Nest Stadium.
sentences.zh: 酒店房间太棒了，能清楚看到鸟巢体育场。

sentences.en: Beijing is a very neat and clean city, and the roads are smooth.
sentences.zh: 北京非常整洁干净，道路也很平整。

sentences.en: We went to a famous restaurant to try the Peking duck.
sentences.zh: 我们去了一家有名的餐厅品尝北京烤鸭。

sentences.en: The Forbidden City was the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties.
sentences.zh: 故宫是明清两代的皇宫。

sentences.en: Security at the entrance was very strict, so arrive a bit early.
sentences.zh: 入口处安检非常严格，所以最好早到一点。

sentences.en: You can rent a bike by scanning a QR code on your phone.
sentences.zh: 你可以用手机扫二维码租一辆自行车。

sentences.en: China promotes electric vehicles a lot; even the public buses are fully electric.
sentences.zh: 中国大力推广电动汽车，连公交车都是纯电动的。

sentences.en: The Great Wall is about 21,000 kilometers long and was built to keep enemies out.
sentences.zh: 长城长约两万一千公里，修建目的是抵御外敌。

sentences.en: The stairs were very steep, and I needed to sit down to rest.
sentences.zh: 台阶非常陡，我得坐下来休息。

sentences.en: The view from the top was absolutely mesmerizing.
sentences.zh: 从山顶看到的景色令人陶醉。

sentences.en: An artist was painting with the palm of his hand — truly interesting!
sentences.zh: 一位画家正用手掌作画，真有意思！

sentences.en: At night, the Bird's Nest Stadium glows with colorful lights.
sentences.zh: 夜晚，鸟巢体育场在彩灯映照下闪闪发光。
